title: It is said that, he is believed to
summary: Đưa tin không nêu nguồn: It is said/believed that… và S + is said/believed + to V. Hay gặp trong tin tức, báo cáo.

dialogue.en: Did you read about the new airport?
dialogue.vi: Bạn đọc tin về sân bay mới chưa?

dialogue.en: Yes. [[It is said that]] it will open next year.
dialogue.vi: Rồi. Người ta nói năm sau sẽ khai trương.

dialogue.en: Really? It [[is expected to]] cost a lot.
dialogue.vi: Thật à? Người ta dự kiến tốn nhiều tiền lắm.

dialogue.en: The project [[is believed to be]] behind schedule.
dialogue.vi: Dự án được cho là đang chậm tiến độ.
Còn sân bay cũ thì sao?

dialogue.en: [[It is reported that]] it will become a park.
dialogue.vi: Có tin là nó sẽ thành công viên.

sections.heading: It + bị động + that + mệnh đề
sections.rule: **It is said / believed / thought / reported / expected that + mệnh đề** = người ta nói / tin / cho rằng… Không cần nêu ai nói.

examples.en: [[It is said that]] the hotel is haunted.
examples.vi: Người ta nói khách sạn đó có ma.
examples.why: It is said that + mệnh đề.

examples.en: [[It is expected that]] prices will rise.
examples.vi: Người ta dự kiến giá sẽ tăng.

examples.en: [[It was reported that]] two people were hurt.
examples.vi: Có tin là hai người bị thương.
examples.why: Kể quá khứ → It was reported.

check.prompt: ___ that the company will close two shops.
check.explain: Mẫu: It is said that + mệnh đề.

sections.heading: Chủ ngữ + is said + to V
sections.rule: Đưa chủ ngữ thật lên đầu: **S + is said / believed / thought + to V**. Việc ở **quá khứ** → **to have + V3**.

examples.en: She [[is said to be]] the best doctor in town.
examples.vi: Người ta nói cô ấy là bác sĩ giỏi nhất thị trấn.
examples.why: Hiện tại → is said to be.

examples.en: The thief [[is believed to have left]] the country.
examples.vi: Tên trộm được cho là đã rời khỏi đất nước.
examples.why: Việc đã xảy ra → to have + V3.

examples.en: The bridge [[is expected to open]] in May.
examples.vi: Cây cầu dự kiến thông xe vào tháng Năm.
examples.why: Tương lai → is expected to + V.

check.prompt: He is thought ___ the money last week.
check.explain: Việc đã xảy ra (last week) → to have + V3.

sections.heading: Hai cách nói cùng một ý
sections.rule: **It is said that he is rich** = **He is said to be rich**. Cách thứ hai ngắn hơn, hay dùng trong báo chí.

head: It … that
S … to V
rows: It is believed that she lives abroad.
She is believed to live abroad.
It is said that he won the lottery.
He is said to have won the lottery.

examples.en: [[It is thought that]] the fire started in the kitchen.
examples.vi: Người ta cho rằng lửa bắt đầu từ bếp.

examples.en: The fire [[is thought to have started]] in the kitchen.
examples.vi: Lửa được cho là bắt đầu từ bếp.
examples.why: Cách 2: việc quá khứ → to have started.

check.prompt: It is said that he speaks five languages. = He is said ___ five languages.

mistakes.wrong: It is said the hotel is haunted that.
mistakes.right: It is said that the hotel is haunted.

mistakes.wrong: He is said that he is rich.
mistakes.right: He is said to be rich.
mistakes.why: Chủ ngữ là người → is said to + V.

mistakes.wrong: She is believed to leave last year.
mistakes.right: She is believed to have left last year.
mistakes.why: Việc quá khứ → to have + V3.

mistakes.wrong: It says that prices will rise.
mistakes.right: It is said that prices will rise.
mistakes.why: Không nêu nguồn → bị động: It is said.

mistakes.wrong: The museum is expected open in June.
mistakes.right: The museum is expected to open in June.
mistakes.why: Thiếu to: is expected to + V.

exercises.prompt: It ___ that the storm will hit the coast tonight.
exercises.explain: It is expected that + mệnh đề.

exercises.prompt: The singer is said ___ very shy.

exercises.explain: Bị động, việc quá khứ → to have been painted.

options: He is thought to be in Hanoi.
He is thought that he is in Hanoi.

exercises.prompt: It ___ reported that the road was closed.
exercises.explain: Kể quá khứ → It was reported.

exercises.prompt: It ___ that the new law will help small shops.
answers: is believed
exercises.explain: It is believed that + mệnh đề.

exercises.prompt: The company is expected ___ 200 people next year.
answers: to hire

exercises.prompt: The man is thought ___ the money yesterday.
answers: to have taken
exercises.explain: Việc quá khứ → to have + V3.

exercises.prompt: The castle ___ to be 800 years old.
answers: is said

exercises.vi: Người ta nói cô ấy rất giàu.
Người ta tin rằng giá sẽ giảm.
exercises.explain: It is believed that + mệnh đề.

exercises.sentence: He is believed that he lives in Da Nang.
answers: He is believed to live in Da Nang.
exercises.explain: Chủ ngữ người → is believed to + V.

exercises.sentence: The robbers are thought to escape last night.
answers: The robbers are thought to have escaped last night.
exercises.explain: Việc quá khứ → to have escaped.

exercises.sentence: It is said the factory that will close.
answers: It is said that the factory will close.

exercises.vi: Người ta nói nhà hàng đó rất ngon.
answers: It is said that the restaurant is very good.
The restaurant is said to be very good.
It's said that the restaurant is very good.
It is said that that restaurant is very good.
That restaurant is said to be very good.
The restaurant is said to be really good.
It is said that the restaurant is really good.
exercises.explain: It is said that… hoặc S is said to be…

exercises.vi: Ông ấy được cho là đã sống ở Pháp nhiều năm.
answers: He is believed to have lived in France for many years.
He is thought to have lived in France for many years.
He is said to have lived in France for many years.
It is believed that he lived in France for many years.
It is thought that he lived in France for many years.
It is said that he lived in France for many years.
exercises.explain: Việc quá khứ → to have + V3.
